complexity.notes: Decode would be O(n) if it tracked an integer offset into the original string instead of reassigning `s` to a sliced copy each iteration. `s.index('|')` also scans from position 0 each time, though with bounded per-string lengths this is secondary to the slicing cost.
complexity.summary: Encodes each string as `length|content` concatenated together; decode repeatedly finds the next `|`, parses the length prefix, extracts that many characters, and re-slices the remainder. Encoding is linear in total characters, but decoding is quadratic because each iteration copies the remaining string with `s = s[...:]`.
